properties.entry: WITH CUSTOMER_MONTH_BILL_DATA AS( SELECT KCA.ID_CUSTOMER, SUM(CASE WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '15 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST / 2 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_SERVICE_COST FROM KYC_CUSTOMER_SERVICE KCS INNER JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_APPLICATION KCA ON KCS.FOLIO = KCA.ID LEFT JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_RELATION_BILL KCSRB ON KCS.ID =KCSRB.ID_CUSTOMER_SERVICE LEFT JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_BILL_CONTROL KCBC ON KCSRB.ID_BILL = KCBC.ID WHERE KCS.ACTIVE = TRUE AND KCBC.ID_STATUS IS NULL AND (KCBC.ISSUE_DATE IS NULL OR ( KCBC.ISSUE_DATE >= DATE_TRUNC('month',CURRENT_DATE) AND KCBC.ISSUE_DATE < DATE_TRUNC('month',CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' )) GROUP BY KCA.ID_CUSTOMER ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS ID, ID_CUSTOMER,TOTAL_SERVICE_COST FROM CUSTOMER_MONTH_BILL_DATA WHERE TOTAL_SERVICE_COST > 0 ORDER BY ID_CUSTOMER
